Package.Name: Ntfy
Package.Author: Elie Bertret
Package.Description: Sends push notifications via ntfy (ntfy.sh or self-hosted) - exposes a Shared Notify handler any other package can call

Setting.name: ServerUrl
Setting.description: Base URL of the ntfy server (the public instance, or your own self-hosted one), no trailing path.

Setting.name: DefaultTopic
Setting.description: Topic to publish to when a Notify call doesn't specify one.

Setting.name: Username
Setting.description: For a protected topic/self-hosted instance using account auth (Basic). Leave both Username and AccessToken empty for an unauthenticated public topic.

Setting.name: AccessToken
Setting.description: ntfy access token (Bearer auth) - an alternative to Username/Password, and preferred when both are set (easier to scope/rotate/revoke than an account password).
